title: Split-diopter two-plane focus lens
blurb: One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas splits focus along a draggable diagonal optical boundary so a close-up foreground HTML cue card and a distant background scene panel stay sharp at once, with bokeh blur across the defocused halves.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas render a close-up foreground HTML card and a distant background HTML panel sharply side-by-side across an adjustable optical seam while blurring each defocused half and keeping controls in both planes clickable?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160.0.8188.0 canary (2026-11-27): 5/5 live checks pass (1.02 MP, 8.2 MB at 412 px DPR 2.625), mipmapped 24-tap Vogel bokeh clears single-lens vs split-diopter focus, and elementsFromPoint() plus pointer clicks hit controls in both planes. Chrome 159 on Android stays not verified.
